title: A Hand-Written Stride View
prompt: Implement `strideView(vec, k)` returning a type with begin()/end() that walks every k-th element (k >= 1). Iterate the returned view in the usual range-for.

tests.name: stride walks every k-th element
tests.hint: Iterator holds pointer-to-vector, index, and k; operator* returns (*v)[i]; operator+= (k) advances; end is index >= size.

tests.name: k of 1 is the identity
tests.hint: Stride 1 visits everything — the degenerate case must work.

tests.name: empty and short inputs
tests.hint: begin == end immediately when data is empty — no dereference may happen.
